elbow_flex.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: "Continue pressing until your elbows are fully extended, but not locked" (illustrative 15 degrees); no exact bent-start angle is given, so the starting position at the chest is illustrative at 90 degrees, matching a loaded machine start

torso_lean.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: "Your shoulder blades should continue to make contact with the backrest and not round or bend forward"

muscles.peakSource: ACE Seated Chest Press: the rep works toward the elbows "fully extended, but not locked," so chest effort is highest approaching that near-extended top

mistake.name: Round and lock

tells.text: The shoulder blades round forward off the backrest to finish the press.
The elbows slam all the way to a hard lockout instead of stopping just short.

mistake.source: ACE Seated Chest Press: "A very frequent mistake is when individuals will press the bar to a point where the shoulder blades round themselves forward and move off the backrest"; Gravitus Chest Press Machine: "Continue pressing until your arms are nearly straight, but avoid locking out your elbows completely"
